landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Shell the Sheridan
landcats.description:
Shell (nickname: Shelly) is a former airborne tank-type reconnaissance CATS from the special operations forces. With his rapid infiltration capabilities and heavy armament, he was deployed in numerous missions. He takes pride in those days, holding great honor in having served as a member of one of the finest airborne reconnaissance units. After the end of the Cold War, he formally went through the retirement process and stepped away from the battlefield.

Following his retirement, he transitioned into the role of an instructor, training new airborne soldiers. Thanks to his past experience operating across multiple countries, he naturally developed a fondness for travel. However, upon leaving active duty as an operational unit, he was required to return all of his visual data recording equipment. This, in turn, sparked a desire to once again see the world directly with his own eyes. Around this time, HEMET invited him to join Oshitoky Logistics, and through this opportunity, Shelly began a new journey, traveling the world alongside the team.

He is now a member of Tokis, serving as a reliable guide for the group. Calm and composed by nature, he occasionally clashes with the hot-headed VEE, though in terms of combat ability, Shell’s superior skill allows him to subdue such conflicts swiftly.

equipment.name: 155 Gun-Launcher System 'Little Cat'
equipment.description: It is a 155mm gun-launcher system developed in the United States for airborne-deployed CATS. A first-generation CATS weapon, it was created by upgrading an existing service launcher and remaking it into a personal armament. Shell removed the stock to improve mobility and calls this variant the 'Little Kitten.'

equipment.name: MBHS-Multifunctional boonie hat system
equipment.description: MBHS was developed for airborne-deployed CATS. It can be equipped with everything from night vision to precision headsets for sound amplification.

equipment.name: CNVG-551 'Window'
equipment.description: A special CNVG issued to the 551 model provides high-sensitivity thermal imaging and night vision. It also features camera functionality, making it specialized for reconnaissance, and it is shaped like a window.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Hemet the HEMTT
landcats.description:
HEMET is a former member of the LANDCATS who was discharged due to injuries. He now works as an arms dealer, running his own logistics company, Oshitoky Logistics. Though small in scale, the group operates like mercenaries and is frequently hired thanks to their solid reputation and skill. Far from being an ordinary shipping service, they specialize in conflict-zone logistics — delivering everything from perfectly ordinary, safe supplies to high-risk materials, whether into war-torn regions or peaceful territories alike.

HEMET wears a tarp-like device resembling pants to conceal his injuries, and he reacts with extreme anger if anyone tries to remove it. Beneath it, his old body made of discontinued parts gives off a bizarre impression, which seems to be connected to his phobia of PROTOs.

Upon his discharge, he returned his Crewmate, a decision he sometimes regrets when he feels its absence. His personality changes noticeably depending on whether he’s wearing his glasses — without them, he becomes cheerful and laid back, but when he puts them on, he turns serious and nerdy.

equipment.name: HEMTTIA 150
equipment.description: It is a type of backpack developed by Hemet that uses its own tail for fastening. A branded product of Hemet, it is designed for use by CATS with tails made of cords, like Hemet’s.

equipment.name: CNVG-88 'NERDY'
equipment.description: It is a pair of night vision and thermal goggles developed by Hemet, called Nedry, which look like glasses. They give off a nerdy appearance.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Vee the Humvee
landcats.description:
VEE is another member of the LANDCATS who, like HEMET, transitioned from the regular army to a private enterprise. He currently works at OSHITOKY LOGISTICS and has a long-standing history with HEMET, having worked with him since before their current venture. As a result, the two have great chemistry and work well together.

He has a fiery personality and tends to rush into things, but HEMET usually steps in to keep him in check. VEE sees HEMET like an older brother, though he sometimes gets too ahead of himself. In fact, as proof of this impulsiveness, he’s gone as far as tattooing the company logo on what he personally considers his most sensitive body part.

VEE previously served as an infantry support CATS, and after joining the company, he now operates as HEMET’s escort vehicle. He loves close-quarters, hand-to-hand combat the most, but due to the high cost of repairing his parts afterward, HEMET constantly finds himself stressed out over it.

equipment.name: CLAW System
equipment.description: This is a combat knife designed like a cat’s claw, serving as auxiliary equipment for lightweight CATS that engage in hand-to-hand combat. Lightweight CATS are required to use the knife, but since it is a retractable blade integrated with the hand, it allows for a wide variety of attacks in emergencies.

equipment.name: CVS-7 'Mono eye'
equipment.description: This CVS is an auxiliary device designed primarily for CATS with damaged eyes. It is mounted on one side and compensates for vision during combat, providing thermal imaging and night vision. It is typically operated by infantry-unit CATS.

landcats.creator: Presto
landcats.name: Bmd the BMD-4
landcats.description:
The BMD is a CATS developed as a modernized modification of the BMD-4 model, adopted under Russia’s combat vehicle replacement program, Project: Zheleznaya Koshka. It is a small airborne combat reconnaissance CATS, designed to be dropped from transport aircraft together with paratroopers for deep infiltration into enemy rear areas. During airdrops, it is deployed individually along with the soldiers and its own armaments.

Although rather old-fashioned, producing engine noises whenever it moves, which it personally regards as a flaw, the paratroopers do not consider it a drawback, as the sound of its engine is said to give them a sense of comfort.

It is currently on active duty and maintains a rivalry with the M551 model CATS Shell. Both were deployed for the same objectives during the Cold War, but after a brief skirmish and subsequent withdrawal, they suffered heavy losses among their units. Since then, they have lived as bitter adversaries. More recently, it has even encountered Shell, now working as a Tokis, in conflict zones.

equipment.name: DBCW-927 'Malen’kiy Drug'
equipment.description: This is a Russian variation of the Double-Barrel CATS Weapon system, a personal armament invented for CATS. It is equipped with a 30 mm large-caliber cannon and a 100 mm grenade launcher.

landcats.creator: ToasTee
landcats.name: Tetril the EOD Vu
landcats.description: An EOD unit with encyclopedic knowledge of explosives, has developed a love for them and the risks associated with its task. Despite having availability for long range and precision disposal tools, prefers to disarm explosives hands-on to experience the rush of doing the job themselves... very much to its crewmate's (and face shield) dismay. This method has also helped them study (and later experiment with) the variety of explosives. Any ordinances that he has come into contact with mysteriously disappear.

landcats.creator: Green PC
landcats.name: St. Ogn. Stanisław the Star
landcats.description: Ranked as 'Starszy Ogniomistrz' in the national fire brigade. Has most experience within densely forested areas, thus needs thick treads to traverse the terrain. Powerful winch used to climb, remove blockages and pull others. Searchlight for the darkest and foggiest nights, and of course plenty of tools in his backpack. He has a younger, but larger, brother by the name of Mieczysław, a STAR 266 within the military with a rank of Chorąży. Stasiek's love for forests has also made him befriend an UAZ 469 in forestry.

landcats.creator: Green PC
landcats.name: Chor. Mieczysław the STAR 266
landcats.description: Although he's bigger and has a higher comparable rank, he's actually Stanisław's younger brother. Ranked as a 'Chorąży' (Standard-bearer, this is mostly done as a reference to a Polish meme) has most experience with planning logistics routes and carrying supplies. Has big treads, just like his older brother, which help traverse muddy and more difficult forested terrain. Whenever needed, can carry a ZU-23 anti-aircraft gun instead of cargo, which he can use relatively well.

landcats.creator: YuuStrand_69
landcats.name: Sinclair the CRC
landcats.model: AMX-10 RC Char à Roues Canon

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Helios the HEMTT
landcats.description: A laser powered bane to all things flying designed by an optical technology weapons manufacturer, ICARUS PROJECT. Working as a mercenary, Helios provides a professional level anti-air defenses to any capable buyers.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Arbalest the FV4005
landcats.description: A moving bunker mobilized and made practical as CATS. Faust breaks up the battlefield by being an unmovable wall capable of unleashing pain for those who stood in his way. Appears to adopt an exaggerated chivalric persona while in battle.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Faust the Maus
landcats.description: A hot headed demolition expert wielding an oversized muzzle-loader. Arbalest's usual solutions to problem is always pure brute force despite the crudeness, as nothing gets rid of obstacle faster than a well measured explosive.

landcats.creator: A Droppa Inc.
landcats.name: Grad the Tunguska
landcats.description: An always jolly and trigger happy gunner, stationed at a secret military compound within the snowy landscape of northern Russia. While always joyful, Grad's demeanor changes drastically when spotting a potential spy within vicinity.

landcats.creator: Félix Auréle
landcats.name: Mikhail the Merkava
landcats.description:
Usually cold and unfeeling, unless he's talking abt The Monolith, has a tendency of spending long periods of time with no sleep, being very methodical. doesnt like to interact much with others

Crewmate personality: Ilyusha's the more sociable one, often keeping Mikhail's bluntness in check

Extra info: He carries a foldable 120mm rifle, a 7.62x54mm PKM and often a 12.7x55mm DShK machinegun. he's often seen carrying around a strange lamp with a hazy blue glow. peeps that get near it too long report headaches and even hearing voices...

landcats.creator: Kiote
landcats.name: Ghost the Karl-Gerat
landcats.description:
Ghost was created when his country was in a war with a far bigger country and knowing that they could never hope to match the enemy with numbers decided to create project O.W.F.P

Or project overwhelming firepower. Where they poured almost all their resources into creating a single cat in hopes the pure power of the 60cm cannon he had would turn the tides of the war. But his rushed construction caused many faults including the extreme exhaust he created upon start up and whenever he fires his gun, this exhaust issue was unable to be fixed as all resources were swapped over to creating ammo for the ghost right after he was completed. And ultimately his country was forced to surrender shortly after. So ghost became a wanderer before he was found and recruited into the black void where he went under some modifications, fixing the exhaust upon start up issue but increasing exhaust caused by firing his weapon.

landcats.creator: Yehnie
landcats.name: Aura the Mjölner
landcats.description:
AURA became a specialist due to her ability to accurately hit targets, as far as records show she hasn't missed a single target. Due to this fact she's known as a valuable target.

She's able to carry one personnel (Driver) and prefers it that way, as she would rather have a bond with a singular living entity at any given time. However, AURA is rebellious, and if her current driver goes against multiple of her interests or wrongs her, then she would immediately seize control, restrain the driver inside, and discipline them. Afterwards, she would work on her own until a new driver is assigned to her.

Should the opposite happen, and she's assigned a driver who really works with her, or she simply likes, then she'll let loose and either temporarily turn her driver into her rubbery drone, or hypnotize them with her intoxicating smoke for the duration of their mission, usually at the expense of the driver's consciousness. The driver essentially belongs to AURA during this time. 

Her demeanor is alert and cold towards others at first glance, but being close to her or being one of her drivers, then she'll open up and turn friendly, albeit still alert. Her mere presence is very much menacing/intimidating, as she's not the 'playing around' type (unless she really likes you). She won't hesitate to mortar strike someone either; it's what she's made to do.

Also. Under any circumstances, DO NOT put on her mask; the effects may be irreversible.

landcats.creator: Null
landcats.name: Felo the Blazer
landcats.model: Chevrolet Blazer EV Police Pursuit Vehicle

landcats.creator: Nicky Ferrius
landcats.name: Leonard the Alpine Hammer
landcats.description:
Leonard is one of the cavalerie Bravo units defending his territory from any adversary.
But he is very friendly and enjoys a drink.

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Sniper Fox the Grille
landcats.description: A LANDCATS long-range self-propelled artillery unit with a silent and cold personality, giving him a calm and dignified presence on any battlefield. Armed with a powerful 155mm artillery and a Cheytac Intervention 40mm rifle, alongside his companions Polar Bear A.I. and Scout Wolf, he can decide the fate of his targets even at extreme distances.

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Scout Wolf the NC750X
landcats.description: A retired LANDCATS motorbike unit once used for high-speed pursuit missions, now decommissioned as his registration is near expiration. Small and lightweight, he excels in agile maneuvers and evasive actions. With a custom-built tail designed for close combat, he is well-suited for reconnaissance and intelligence-gathering missions. He lives and works together with Sniper Fox, taking on contracts from various factions to earn a living.

landcats.creator: Kasichi
landcats.name: Lynx the Pháo Tự Hành
landcats.description: A LANDCATS long-range self-propelled artillery unit developed by Viettold Military Industry and Telecoms Group. As one of the newest units, still in trial missions, he has already shown precise calculations and excellent marksmanship down to the finest detail. However, being recently assembled, Lynx often comes across as cold and distant. Lately, though, teammates have noticed him showing more warmth and learning to interact more closely with humans.

landcats.creator: ScarTheWerewolf
landcats.name: Scar the Abrams X
landcats.description: An independent mercenary Landcat without a master to serve, he accepts every contract from every factions he met. He once saved a Proto from the ruined Factory and now he with his Proto companion travels around the battlefield to seek more work and place to stay.

equipment.name: XM360 Shoulder Mounted Cannon
equipment.description: Primary Ammo: 120×570mm APSDF, Special Ammo: 120x570mm APHESDF and 120x570mm DUFSDS, Magazine load: 5 + 1, Firing mode: Semi-auto

equipment.name: HC-7 .50 AE
equipment.description: SECONDARY WEAPON, Primary Ammo: .50 AE JHP, Special Ammo: .50 AE AP, .50 AE HP, .50 AE API, Magazine load: 7 + 1, Firing mode: Semi-auto

equipment.name: GADGETS/EQUIPMENTS
equipment.description: Combat Interface Display Unit Goggles, Detachable External Backpack, Shoulder Fog lights and Camera

equipment.name: 20mm M139 Autocannon
equipment.description: Based on the same model used in the XM800T platform. Mounted on an interchangeable modular base, allowing rapid replacement in the event of damage. High rate of fire and optimized for suppression of light armored targets, drones, and reconnaissance units.

equipment.name: 7.62mm Machine Gun (assumed)
equipment.description: Auxiliary weapon for close-range defense and anti-personnel engagement. Integrated with servo-linked targeting systems for synchronized operation with the main cannon.

equipment.name: Reinforced Servo Framework
equipment.description: Provides enhanced structural stability and recoil absorption during firing. Includes an automatic balance correction system under load or uneven terrain conditions.

equipment.name: Advanced Optical Suite
equipment.description: Developed through private-sector collaboration with the regular army. Combines night vision, infrared, and electronic warfare detection capabilities for long-range scouting and target acquisition.

landcats.creator: Espero
landcats.name: Duban the Yuk-gong
landcats.description: This cat is an unarmed military transport vehicle developed for the Republic of Korea Armed Forces for personnel and material transport. Equipped with a simple powertrain, it can carry a backpack-style cargo bed or tow a carrier-style trailer for transport. It is equipped with basic lighting equipment for use on civilian roads. It can travel at a maximum speed of 86 km/h, can accommodate up to 20 passengers, and can carry up to 4 tons in its cargo hold. Its maximum gradeability is 60 degrees and its range is 530 km. A bonnet is attached to the chest for easy maintenance.
